questions.q: About how much honey does one worker bee make in her whole life?
questions.fact: Only about 1/12 of a teaspoon! It takes thousands of bees working together to fill a single jar.

questions.q: How do bees dry watery nectar into thick honey?
choices: They bake it in the sun
They fan it with their wings
questions.fact: They fan their wings! The airflow evaporates water from the nectar until it becomes honey.

questions.q: What do bees seal a finished cell of honey with?
questions.fact: A beeswax cap. Worker bees make wax from special glands on the underside of their abdomen.
